title: PlotPickle OSS and third-party registry
purpose: Canonical public inventory for open-source systems, direct npm dependencies, reviewed third-party assets, materially adopted OSS references, and explicitly excluded non-OSS connections used by PlotPickle.

npm.coverage: All direct runtime/development dependencies are audited from package.json and every installed package licence expression is inventoried from package-lock.json.

influencePolicy.definition: A reference-only marker means the named OSS project materially informed current PlotPickle architecture, methodology, or an adapted workflow. Evaluation-only, future, standards-only, and ordinary external links are not contributors until adopted.

systems.name: Node.js
systems.plotpickleUse: The Windows installer bundles the Node.js distribution used to run PlotPickle; the release workflow pins Node 24.19.0.
systems.distribution: Bundled in the Windows installer. Node's upstream LICENSE also carries notices for its separately maintained third-party components.

systems.name: React
systems.plotpickleUse: Primary user-interface runtime.

systems.name: Vite
systems.plotpickleUse: Application development/build runtime and local server foundation.

systems.name: Vinext
systems.plotpickleUse: Next-compatible application runtime used by the current PlotPickle build.

systems.name: Mastra
systems.plotpickleUse: Host runtime for bounded PlotPickle agents and agent orchestration.

systems.name: Vercel AI SDK
systems.plotpickleUse: Provider-neutral AI runtime primitives used behind PlotPickle-owned capability boundaries.

systems.name: Drizzle ORM
systems.plotpickleUse: Database/data access tooling.

systems.name: libsodium / libsodium-wrappers-sumo
systems.plotpickleUse: Cryptographic primitives for PlotPickle Auth and profile protection.

systems.name: Tailwind CSS
systems.plotpickleUse: CSS/tooling dependency in the shipped application stack.

systems.name: BUZZ
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional Community runtime for signed rooms, Communities, membership and presence.
systems.distribution: PlotPickle ships the reviewed compose/manifest/licence metadata; pinned container images are downloaded only after explicit user installation.

systems.name: Ollama
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional local text/model runtime reached through reviewed loopback capability routing; PlotPickle does not bundle Ollama.

systems.name: llama.cpp
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional local model runtime/compatible endpoint; PlotPickle does not bundle llama.cpp.

systems.name: ComfyUI
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional local image/video workflow runtime on a reviewed loopback boundary; PlotPickle does not bundle the ComfyUI application.

systems.name: FFmpeg / ffprobe
systems.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later by default; GPL-2.0-or-later when GPL components/options are enabled
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional local media measurement executables used by Sequence Evidence for metadata, keyframes and bounded frame-difference evidence. PlotPickle does not bundle or silently install FFmpeg/ffprobe.
systems.distribution: User-managed executable. The applicable FFmpeg licence depends on how that particular build was configured.

systems.name: Lazy Frames
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional local deterministic animatic tool installed to PlotPickle's reviewed tool home only after explicit user action.

systems.name: Portless
systems.plotpickleUse: Isolated developer-tool runtime for local endpoint ergonomics; it is not a PlotPickle product authority.

systems.name: Pi coding agent
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional external developer/repair worker; not part of the PlotPickle user runtime.

systems.name: Cline
systems.plotpickleUse: Optional external developer/repair worker; not part of the PlotPickle user runtime.

systems.name: ReelBench Skills
systems.plotpickleUse: Sequence Evidence adapts the discipline of machine-measured facts, bounded model annotation and deterministic validation gates. PlotPickle's implementation is native; no ReelBench source code, demo media or report assets are copied.

systems.name: BERD
systems.plotpickleUse: Architectural reference for managed sidecars, pinned runtime dependencies, lifecycle checks and validation patterns. No BERD/Goose product authority or BERD source dependency is introduced.

systems.name: Lightricks ComfyUI-LTXVideo pinned workflow
systems.plotpickleUse: PlotPickle's reviewed single-stage LTX proof graph adapts the pinned upstream distilled workflow and records the exact source revision in product architecture/source evidence.

systems.name: ComfyUI LTX-Video workflow template
systems.plotpickleUse: PlotPickle's reviewed LTX default workflow uses the published Comfy-Org LTXV text-to-video template as an adaptation/reference source, with provenance recorded in the architecture note.

thirdPartyAssets.name: Stable Diffusion XL Base 1.0
thirdPartyAssets.source: Stability AI stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0 via Hugging Face
thirdPartyAssets.plotpickleUse: Optional reviewed local image-model starter. The exact file size and SHA-256 are pinned before activation.

nonOssConnections.name: LM Studio
nonOssConnections.reason: Supported as an optional user-managed compatible endpoint, but not represented by PlotPickle as an open-source dependency and therefore excluded from OSS acknowledgements.

nonOssConnections.name: Configured cloud/BYOK providers
nonOssConnections.reason: External service/provider connections are not automatically OSS dependencies. Their own terms apply and they are excluded from the OSS acknowledgement unless a specific open-source component is separately registered.
